text: Title screen: white text on light blue (115,166,230) has contrast ~2.5:1, below WCAG 4.5:1 for the small 'Press any key or click to continue' line.
Bottom-right Season panel overlaps the Energy bar (text 'Energy 84' half-hidden) and the Inventory panel bottom-left is cut off at the screen edge (Apples row clipped) at 960x540.

After founding my settlement (tick ~6970) and entering it, the era checklist still shows '[ ] Village 0/1'. Unclear what 'Village' means if a founded settlement does not count. Also a huge world-space label '0 here, 5/8 residents' renders behind the HUD panels at the top, partly hidden.

By tick ~9100 (3 game minutes) every Village requirement except the day gate was met with no player effort: pawns joined Eastford automatically (Members 10/10) and NPCs built all 4 market stalls within 30 s of founding (ticks 7350-7902). Objective 6 'Build a market stall' completed from Alice Brown's stall, not mine, so the player never builds one. Remaining 14 minutes are pure waiting for Day 3.
Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: 'bers 10/10 • Buildings 2/2' (should read 'Members 10/10 · Buildings 2/2'). It also says 'Buildings' while the era checklist says 'Stalls 2/2'.

After H (Teleport Home) the player lands 5.4 m from the settlement centre; E then says 'No entities within range to interact with' (interact range is 5) although the bottom bar offers 'Enter Settlement'. Clicking the button works. Expected H to land within E range.

Settlement Info shows 'Tier: Town (7 buildings)' and the label 'Town of Eastford' at Day 2 while the era is still 'Camp (1/4)' and the goal is the Village era. NPC caravans also addressed it as 'Village of Eastford' at tick 9002. Two different Camp/Village/Town ladders (settlement tier vs nation era) using the same words is confusing; the pawns built 7 buildings on their own.

Village era reached at tick 51002 (1020 s, exactly the day-3 gate). Also: inside the settlement the bottom button row wraps to two lines and 'Purchase Food' overlaps the Market Info prices (Planks/Bricks rows); Town checklist shows 'Funds 565/1000' while Settlement Info says Funds: 12, unclear what is counted.
